@Gigi_beach_dubai is a stunning Italian restaurant and beach club located at @j1beachdubai 🇮🇹🍋

This is a must visit if you’re looking for amazing Italian food or a chilled pool and beach day in Dubai. 

If you are visiting the restaurant it opens at 12pm-1am but the best time to visit is from 2pm onwards when they have a live DJ.

The Adults only pool and beach access is available from 10am-7pm daily. 

Pool Sunbeds pricing: 

AED 300 (Weekdays) fully redeemable on F&B 
AED 400 (Weekends) 50% redeemable on F&B
